why: the material the reader would see, shown in the card

alt.doc: kind, what it shows, and its point

html.doc: the exhibit markup (table, mock screen, svg, pre)

kit.doc: a kit tree (see kit-tree) instead of html

cls.doc: class of the exhibit box, such as mk

facts.doc: what the exhibit shows, each as it appears in it; rivals cite them by index

props.doc: option exhibits: property -> value, so differs-one can compare options

elements.text: Which dish should the bot's first question name, given the tally shown?

elements.alt: Table of the week's tally: A 10, B 40, C 20, D 10 of 80 orders

elements.why: B holds 40 of the 80 orders, so one question ends half of the games.
A is first on the menu, but it holds only 10 of the 80 orders.
elements.right_when: every dish is ordered equally often

elements.why: C holds 20 of the orders, so asking it first lengthens the common path.
elements.right_when: C were the most ordered dish
